mapper.select: SELECT * FROM platform_account WHERE username=#{username} AND delete_flag=0
SELECT * FROM platform_account WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=0
SELECT * FROM platform_account WHERE delete_flag=0 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM platform_account WHERE delete_flag=0
SELECT count(*) FROM platform_account WHERE delete_flag=0 AND status=1
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_account SET status=#{status}, credential_version=credential_version + CASE WHEN #{status}=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=0
UPDATE platform_account SET password=#{hash},force_reset_pwd=#{forceReset}, credential_version=credential_version+1,updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=0
UPDATE platform_account SET name=#{name},updated_by=#{operatorId},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=0
